title: Landscape Architecture
description: Master planning, site analysis, and full design documentation. We work from first survey through construction administration — drawings every contractor on site can build from without guessing.
bullets: Site analysis & topographic survey coordination
Master plans and phased build-out strategies
Construction documents, planting plans, lighting plans
Permitting & conservation-district liaison
Construction administration with weekly site visits

title: Hardscape & Masonry
description: Bluestone terraces, dry-laid fieldstone walls, custom pools, fire pits, outdoor kitchens — built by our own crews under a master mason. We don't sub out the stonework.
bullets: Bluestone, limestone, and granite paving
Dry-laid and mortared fieldstone walls
Pool & spa coordination with licensed builders
Custom fire features and outdoor kitchens
Drainage, grading, and structural engineering

title: Planting & Horticulture
description: Native and naturalized plantings sourced from a small network of growers we've worked with for years. Mature specimen installation, meadow restoration, and four-season palettes.
bullets: Native plant palettes designed for site conditions
Mature tree and specimen installation up to 8" caliper
Meadow establishment and pollinator habitat
Heirloom kitchen gardens and orchards
Five-year plant warranty on installations

title: Estate Management
description: Ongoing stewardship for the gardens we design. Fine pruning, irrigation, lighting service, and seasonal transitions handled by horticulturists who know your property by name.
bullets: Year-round horticultural care by named team
Fine pruning and structural tree work
Irrigation, lighting, and water-feature service
Seasonal color rotations and bulb programs
Annual landscape report with photos and recommendations
